target.statement: Neural Network accuracy (CA) of 0.76 (reported as 78.57% in text) on Pima Indians Diabetes dataset, stratified 5-fold CV

compute.basis: Tiny 768-row tabular dataset; standard sklearn MLP/classifiers with 5-fold CV run in seconds on CPU, but no code is released so the pipeline (preprocessing, feature selection, hyperparameters) must be re-implemented from a vague description.

blockers: No code released despite paper claiming open-source
Preprocessing/feature-selection/hyperparameter details underspecified, so exact 0.76 may not be hit
Inconsistent numbers between abstract (78.57%) and tables (0.76)
title: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Techniques for Early Prediction of Diabetes
